messages:
Maria Gomez: FYI onboarding request — external weights+tokenizer from 'open-reckoner/alpha-2' (HF repo) need provenance + registry entry. What minimal artifacts to ingest?
Ajay Patel: At minimum we need: model weights file(s), tokenizer files, model card, license, git commit or HF snapshot id, and checksums. Also LFS pointers if used.
Lucy Chen: Also need a CITATION or paper link and inference config (vocab_size, hidden_size, eos_token, pad_token). If quantization planned, include fp16 / int8 baseline metrics.
Sam Turner: For checksums run:
```bash
sha256sum model.bin > model.bin.sha256
sha256sum tokenizer.json > tokenizer.json.sha256
```
Maria Gomez: Where do we put them in the registry? Path conventions?
Ajay Patel: Use registry path: s3://redwood-models/eng-ml/{family}/{name}/{version}/ with metadata file metadata.json that contains: source_url, commit_hash, checksum, license, model_card_url, provenance. Example CLI:
```bash
rwd-cli registry add --name open-reckoner/alpha-2 --version 0.1.0 \  --source https://huggingface.co/open-reckoner/alpha-2@commit/abcd1234 \  --weights s3://uploads/tmp/model.bin --checksum-file model.bin.sha256
```
artifact-ingest-bot: scan complete — warnings: license missing; tokenizer.vocab_size matches weights? unknown.
Lucy Chen: If license missing we cannot onboard to hosted. For Private/Dedicated maybe with legal approval.
Sam Turner: For provenance, capture: who uploaded, uploader_email, original_url, git_commit, dataset used to fine-tune (if any), and a signed artifact token. We also keep a copy of the HF repo snapshot as tar.gz and its checksum.
Maria Gomez: Quick QA: what evals should we run before promoting?
Lucy Chen: Run small-scale pass/fail suite: P0: generation coherence on 50 prompts, P1: toxicity check (toxicspan), P2: perplexity vs baseline, P3: instruction-following on eval set. Record metrics in eval-runner note.
eval-runner: baseline run complete — coherence: 0.87 -> compare to baseline 0.92; flag: possible regressions on long-context.
Ajay Patel: Recommend tagging as 'experimental/needs-quant' and schedule 4-bit/8-bit quant runs; also add quant config file: quant_config.json with quant_type, calibration_dataset, clip_activations boolean.
Maria Gomez: ok, I'll gather missing docs (license + model_card) and re-upload the HF snapshot tar. Thanks all :thumbsup:
